title: Trip lookup: closed trip covers the identification (end_date >= ts)
description: Covering-guard table row 2: end_date >= timestamp, a closed trip covers the identification, link it and set arrived_after_trip_ended. The trip runs and closes live (IGN_OFF at 200); the identification claims atSec 150 (inside [0, 200]) but is not delivered until 250, fifty seconds after the trip already closed. Must prove: the row links to the closed trip, is flagged arrived_after_trip_ended, and both assignees become A. Must NOT change: the checkpoint right after trip end, before the identification is delivered, is the negative control proving the trip close itself did not touch the assignee.

driver_identifications.note: claimed timestamp is inside the trip, but delivered 50 seconds after the trip already closed
